verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents multiple scheduling links, each with its own rules (docs-98, docs-79, docs-69). Per-link locations are covered through Zoom, Meet, and Whereby auto-attach plus per-host meeting locations (docs-22/23/24, docs-81). Booking questions are referenced (docs-85), and payment-gated confirmation means a meeting only lands once payment clears (docs-90). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-link durations, first-party docs on configuring custom booking questions, manual approval or confirmation rules beyond payment gating, and independent hands-on corroboration.
